title: KMRL’s Ridership Zooms Ahead: Records All Time High On 1 January 2020 – Kochi Metro Rail Ltd.

sections.text: The number of people using the Kochi1 card has increased to 73,000, which constitutes 29% of the total ridership. KMRL has also introduced Kochi1 Minor Cards for school children above the age of 10 years, with an aim to ensure safe, efficient and eco-friendly intra-city travel services.
